input.subject: Off-market WV condo - 2BR, $2.65M, quietly available
input.bodyText:
Hi network,

2BR / 2BA condo, ~1,150 sf, wood-burning fireplace
Prewar full-service building, low carrying costs
Asking $2,650,000

Available to show now for serious, pre-qualified buyers only. Co-broke 2.5%. Reply and I'll send the deck privately.

Elena Marsh
Compass
